units: Proposed game world units and seconds; tune through playtesting.
implementationStatus: Design specification only; no enemy AI installed.

common.activation: Only while onscreen or within 100-unit edge margin.
common.reducedMotion: Static warning pose plus icon/sound; no intense flashing.
common.damage: Use existing hurt() and invincibility handling; decoration does not deal damage.

enemies.attack: Expanding sound ring with a clearly marked 70-degree safe gap; no offscreen activation.
enemies.counter: Pass through gap or boost into recovering body.

enemies.attack: Lock target during windup, then straight 0.45s lunge at 430 units/s. No tracking during lunge.
enemies.counter: Sidestep committed path; boost during recovery.

enemies.attack: Capture at most three nearby untaken ordinary coins with original IDs; flee up to 400 units toward a visible burrow.
enemies.counter: Catch otter or burst visible loot bubble. Escape releases every coin at reachable burrow entrance.
enemies.coinSafety: Release coins before despawn, checkpoint reset, stage exit and defeat. Trial mode: disable theft.

enemies.attack: Frontal guard while idle; expose body during seedpod throw. One slow straight projectile at 160 units/s.
enemies.counter: Flank guard or boost during exposed recovery.

enemies.attack: Mark one horizontal current lane, then push for 0.8s. Push alone does not damage. No stun-lock or forced obstacle collision.
enemies.counter: Swim around lane or ride push; exposed head is vulnerable in recovery.

enemies.attack: Spawn two translucent harmless decoys for 3s. Real creature retains solid shadow and bubble marker. Max two decoys per creature.
enemies.counter: Identify marked real creature; decoys pop harmlessly on contact.
